_comment: Tier-2 for febio::elasticity_mms#1. Doubling <density> alone on the generated MMS deck: both runs reach normal termination with exit 0 and no warning; every prescribed boundary node is unchanged to the last digit because they are Dirichlet; and the interior displacement scales by the density ratio. The boundary/interior split is the assertion — a uniform rescaling could be divided back out, and this is not one, which is why the error survives a smoke test. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
